provenance: Authored controlled maintenance verification input. Full-power operation and a deliberately non-limiting 1,000,000 kg opening tritium stock are software-test assumptions, not plant operating data. Fixed blanket replacement lasts 60 days. The blanket integrated-flux threshold is filled from native FARIS TransportDrivingRates to target the archived 79,859,518.2721506 s inter-event operating interval. The horizon contains one completed inter-campaign replacement and stops 600 s before the next trigger. No unplanned outage model is present.
